name: Exchangeable Standardized Effects (ES)
model_likelihood: y_s=mu_s*1+beta_s*g_s+e_s; e_s ~ N(0,sigma_s^2 I); residual errors independent across subgroups.
inference_algorithm: Laplace approximations of Bayes factors; simpler analytic ABFs; optional standardized-effect configuration hierarchy uses MCMC.
estimand: Bayes factors against no association in every subgroup; relative support for alternative heterogeneity models.
data_input: Individual subgroup genotype and quantitative phenotype data or six sufficient summaries; simplest ABF uses standardized effect estimates and standard errors.
tunable_settings: Effect-size and heterogeneity prior scales phi,omega; discrete prior grid and weights; CEFN k and configuration-mixture weights for the optional extension.

name: Exchangeable Effects (EE)
model_likelihood: y_s=mu_s*1+beta_s*g_s+e_s; e_s ~ N(0,sigma_s^2 I); residual errors independent across subgroups.
inference_algorithm: Approximate Bayes factors (ABF_EE) computed from subgroup effect estimates and standard errors.
estimand: Bayes factors against no association in every subgroup; relative support for alternative heterogeneity models.
data_input: Individual subgroup genotype and quantitative phenotype data or six sufficient summaries; simplest ABF uses raw effect estimates and standard errors.
tunable_settings: Effect-size and heterogeneity prior scales psi,w; discrete prior grid and weights.
